label: Proposed Membership Rates
title: ICSH Membership — More Flexible, More Inclusive
paragraphs: We’re making ICSH membership more flexible and accessible to our community.
With 12-month rolling membership, you can enjoy a full year of membership from the date you join or renew.
We’re proposing new membership options to make it easier for more people to become part of the ICSH community.
Pensioner Membership — £15 per year for members aged 66 and above.
Student Membership — FREE for under-21s in full-time education, with the required eligibility declaration.
Whether you’re joining for the first time or renewing, we look forward to welcoming you.
These rates are proposals in the preview only. Live pricing and payments remain unchanged.
